id.tagline: Menyatukan ibadah, pendidikan, dan kebersamaan komunitas Jasinga.
id.heroIntro: Masjid Al Barokah yang berlokasi di Kp. Sipak, Kecamatan Jasinga, Kabupaten Bogor, dibangun melalui semangat gotong royong masyarakat setempat serta dukungan para donatur dari luar kampung yang ikhlas menyisihkan rezekinya demi pembangunan masjid.
id.profileIntro: Masjid Al Barokah kini menjadi pusat ibadah dan diharapkan terus berkembang sebagai tempat pendidikan agama, silaturahmi, serta kegiatan sosial untuk meningkatkan kemakmuran masjid dan memberikan manfaat bagi masyarakat sekitar.

en.tagline: Unifying worship, education, and community togetherness in Jasinga.
en.heroIntro: Masjid Al Barokah, located in Kp. Sipak, Jasinga District, Bogor Regency, was built through the spirit of mutual cooperation of the local community and the support of donors from outside the village who sincerely contributed their wealth for the construction of the mosque.
en.profileIntro: Masjid Al Barokah has now become a center of worship and is expected to continue to develop as a place for religious education, silaturahmi, and social activities to improve the prosperity of the mosque and provide benefits to the surrounding community.
en.feature1Desc: Five daily prayer times, morning studies, and regularly organized community worship.
en.feature2Desc: Regular study held once a month to strengthen knowledge, morals, and relationships.
en.feature3Desc: Social programs and environmental service to realize the spirit of mutual cooperation.
en.eventDesc: Held once a month at the beginning of the month for ukhuwah and religious knowledge development.
en.ann1: Regular Youth Religious Study schedule is held once a month at the beginning of the month.
en.ann2: Construction and cleaning work of the mosque will be carried out after information through the loudspeaker.
